# Requirements

## REQ-001 Seller lists item

functional, must

The system shall allow a seller to list an item with a starting price and an end time.

Acceptance criteria:

- A seller can submit an item with a starting price and an end time and it then appears as an open auction.
- A listing without a starting price or without an end time is rejected with an error message.

## REQ-002 Place bid

functional, must

The system shall allow a bidder to place a bid on an open auction item.

Acceptance criteria:

- A bidder can submit a bid on an item whose end time has not passed and the bid is stored.
- A bid on an item whose end time has passed is rejected.

## REQ-003 Live bid updates

functional, must

The system shall push each new bid to all clients currently watching that item without the client reloading the page.

Acceptance criteria:

- When a bid is accepted, every client watching the item shows the new bid without a page reload.
- A client watching a different item does not receive that bid.

## REQ-004 Auction close and winner

functional, must

The system shall close an auction when its end time is reached and declare the highest bidder the winner.

Acceptance criteria:

- At the end time the item no longer accepts bids.
- The bidder with the highest bid at the end time is recorded as the winner and this is shown to watchers.

## REQ-005 Prices in bidder currency

functional, must

The system shall display prices to a bidder in the bidder's chosen currency, converted using exchange rates obtained from a public exchange rate API.

Acceptance criteria:

- A bidder who selects a currency sees item prices and bids converted with the latest rate obtained from the exchange rate API.
- Converted prices are shown with the currency code.

## REQ-006 Separate services

non-functional, must

The system shall be built as separately deployable services, including at least an API server and a separate live update server.

Acceptance criteria:

- The API server and the live update server run as separate processes or deployments.
- Either service can be started, stopped and deployed without redeploying the other.

## REQ-007 Horizontal scalability

non-functional, should

The system shall allow the API server and the live update server to be scaled independently by running multiple instances.

Acceptance criteria:

- With two or more live update server instances running, a client connected to any instance receives every bid for the item it watches.
- Adding an instance requires no code change.

## Open questions

- Q-001: Do users need accounts and login, and what roles exist (seller, bidder, admin)? Can a seller bid on their own item? (REQ-001, REQ-002)
- Q-002: What are the bid rules: must a bid exceed the current highest bid, is there a minimum increment, and should a late bid extend the end time? (REQ-002, REQ-004)
- Q-003: In which currency are starting prices and bids entered and stored (seller's currency, one fixed base currency, or the bidder's)? Is the conversion for display only? (REQ-005)
- Q-004: What happens if the exchange rate API is unavailable, and is there a preferred API or a limit on how old a cached rate may be? (REQ-005)
- Q-005: What are the scale and latency targets (concurrent watchers, bids per second, maximum delay for a live update)? Also, what happens when an auction ends with no bids, and are payment and winner notification in scope? (REQ-004, REQ-007)
